versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Qwen3-TTS skill for high-quality text-to-speech.
- Features 10 built-in speakers, voice cloning from 3s+ audio, natural-language voice design, and emotional control.
- Supports 10+ languages with persistent, named voices.
- Audio can be delivered as native messages in Telegram and WhatsApp.
- Auto-detects available GPU/CPU hardware for optimal performance.
- Includes detailed setup instructions and usage guidelines for speech generation, voice design, and cloning.
